<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈124–136 ppm) are: 135.43 (×2), 130.70 (×2), 130.40 (×2), 128.70 (×2), 128.35 (×2), 124.85 (×2). Each appears twice, indicating two equivalent carbons for each chemical shift. Summing the multiplicities gives 7 × 2 = 14 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>14</final_answer>
